pages.text: Grandpa Goose was coming to visit today. Pongi had been wiping the floor all morning.
"Grandpa will sit here." Pongi pointed to the biggest chair.
But one chair leg was too short. The chair rattled when Pongi pressed on it.
Dad brought a hammer. "I'll fix it in no time."
Tap! Tap! One leg got even shorter.
Dad tapped the other side too. This time, that side got shorter.
The chair rocked back and forth. Nobody could sit on it.
Knock, knock. Grandpa Goose had arrived.
Grandpa pulled over a cushion and sat on the floor. "I like sitting on the floor."
They all sat on the floor. Pongi glanced at the chair. It rattled away, all by itself.
